app.tagline: EPUB · PDF · DOCX & more · voice reading
app.standalone: standalone preview — open inside Mnemosyne OS for full features

library.title: Library
library.linkPlaceholder: Paste a book link (EPUB, PDF…)  https://…/book.epub
library.emptyBody: Add a book in any format — EPUB, PDF, DOCX, RTF, TXT, HTML, Markdown — and MnemoReader will read it aloud, extracting the text, finding chapters, and vectorizing it into your Library vault. Most formats (EPUB, DOCX, TXT, HTML…) need no OCR.
library.dropSub: EPUB, PDF, DOCX, TXT… — or pick one from disk
library.sample: Try it with a sample story

card.remove: Remove from library (the file on disk is untouched)

confirm.title: Remove “{{title}}”?
confirm.line1: • Removes the book and its local reading copy from MnemoReader.
confirm.line2: • The original file on disk is never touched.
confirm.line3: • What you archived into your Mnemosyne vault stays in your memory — you govern that from the host, not from here.

reader.deepOcrTitle: Re-OCR every page properly (slow, higher quality than an embedded text layer)

dock.prepareTitle: Synthesize the rest of this chapter now, so it plays without ever waiting
dock.prepareStop: Stop preparing — what is already prepared is kept
dock.followAppTitle: Use the engine chosen in Mnemosyne's Settings → Voice
dock.sessionNote: For this reading — your saved settings are untouched.

toast.needHostImport: Run MnemoReader inside Mnemosyne OS to import books.
toast.needHostDownload: Run MnemoReader inside Mnemosyne OS to download books.
toast.needHostOcr: Run MnemoReader inside Mnemosyne OS to OCR.
toast.needHostOpen: Open MnemoReader inside Mnemosyne OS to read this book.
toast.duplicate: That book is already in your library.
toast.folderEmpty: No supported documents in that folder.
toast.badLink: Paste a full http(s) link (e.g. https://…/book.pdf).
toast.linkFailed: The link could not be downloaded.
toast.fileMoved: “{{title}}” — the file has moved or been deleted, and no reading copy was kept. Re-add it from its new location.
toast.removed: Removed “{{title}}”. Your archived memory is untouched.
toast.finished: Finished — the whole book was read.
toast.finishedWithGapsOne: Finished — but 1 passage was passed over and never read aloud.
toast.finishedWithGapsMany: Finished — but {{n}} passages were passed over and never read aloud.
toast.sentenceSkipped: Sentence {{n}} could not be spoken ({{reason}}) and was passed over.
toast.sleepPaused: Sleep timer — playback paused. Good night.
toast.engineNotInstalled: {{name}} is not installed — reading with the system voice.
toast.engineFailed: {{name}} could not speak ({{error}}) — reading with the system voice.
toast.engineSlow: {{name}} synthesizes at {{factor}}× — slower than speech, so the reading will stop now and then to build a lead. Prepare the chapter to listen straight through.
toast.chapterReady: Chapter ready — about {{minutes}} min of audio, no waiting.
toast.chapterPartly: Prepared about {{minutes}} min — that is as much as is kept in memory; the rest synthesizes as you listen.
toast.sourceGone: The source file is no longer where it was imported from (moved, renamed or deleted?): {{path}}
toast.noVoiceForLanguage: No {{language}} voice is available — this book will be read with a {{fallback}} voice.
toast.noVoiceForLanguageUnknown: No {{language}} voice is available — this book will be read with the configured voice.
